spans.s: + आरोहण पवित्र- + आरोहण, n. the name of a festival, Pañc. 34, 18.
+ आशिन् पवन- + आशिन्, m. a snake.
+ तनय पवन- + तनय, m. Hanumant, the son of the wind.
† पव् पव्, i. 1, Ātm. To go (v. r.).
पव, i. e. पू + अ, n. Cowdung.

पवन, i. e. पू + अन,
 I. m.
 1. Wind, air, Śāk. d. 55.
 2. A potter's kiln, Böhtl. Ind.

. A proper name.
 II. m. (or n.) The sacred fire. []
 --Comp.

पावन, i. e. पू + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Purifying,

. A proper name.
 III. f. नी, The name of a river.
 IV. n.
 1. Purifying,

पवमान (properly ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. of पू, i. 1), m.
 1. Wind,

. Agni, the deified fire.
 3. The moon.

पवि, m.
 1. The iron band of a wheel (ved.).
 2. The thunderbolt of Indra, Śatr. 14, 219. Perhaps akin to Lat. pavire, puvire; παίω, πταίω.

पवित्र, i. e. पू + त्र,
 I. n.
 1. A means of purifying,

.
 II. m. pl. The name of a class of deities.
 III. f. त्रा, The name of a river.
 IV. adj., f. त्रा.
 1. Purifying,

पवित्र + क,
 I. n. The vessel in which an Argha or oblation is presented(?), Yājñ. 1, 250.
 II. As latter part of comp. adj., a substitute for पवित्र.
 --Comp.
पवित्र + ता, f., and पवित्रत्व पवित्र + त्व, n. Purity, Utt.
पवित्रय, a denomin. derived from पवित्र with अय, Par. To purify.

पवित्रिन्, i. e. पवित्र + इन्, adj.
 1. Purifying,

पावक, i. e. पू + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Belonging to Agni, Utt.

. Pure.
 II. m.
 1. Fire, or its deified personification,

. A kind of Ṛṣi.
 3. Name of several plants.
पावकि, i. e. पावक + इ, patronym., m. A son of fire, i. e. Kārttikeya.
पावमानी, i. e. पवमान (vb. पू), + अ + ई, f. The name of hymns referring to the preparation of the सोम,
पावर, a corrupt form of द्वापर, The die which is marked with two points,
